title: Thermally activated delayed fluorescence materials: innovative design and advanced application in biomedicine, catalysis and electronics

TADF materials enable high-efficiency light emission via reverse intersystem crossing. Advanced designs enhance their role in OLEDs, photocatalysis, and bioimaging, offering tunable optoelectronic properties for next-generation applications.
